subject: Request: approval for non-standard Hosted API pricing for CardinalIQ
messages:
From: David Liu <david.liu@cardinaliq.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation and preferred commercial structure

Ben —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. CardinalIQ is excited about the latency and multi-region routing — this maps to a lot of our product roadmap. We have a procurement constraint: to win internal approval we need a blended unit price that reflects our committed volume.

Ask: a 30% discount on list Hosted API token rates for a 12-month committed consumption (estimated 1.2B tokens/mo) plus a clause to reserve a customer-dedicated routing lane. Can Redwood commit to that discount and to a 99.9% availability SLA on the dedicated lane?

If you can get close we can push for an accelerated signature (SOW attached on our side).

-David

On Mon, Sep 11, 2028 at 15:30 Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Appreciate the time today, David — follow-up with the materials.
>
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: David Liu <david.liu@cardinaliq.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation and preferred commercial structure

David —

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick reality check: 30% is outside standard delegated pricing and will need exec signoff. Preliminary internal proposal from my side: 25% off list Hosted API token rates for a 12-month firm commit (with a minimum monthly spend) plus a contractual clause to guarantee routing priority and a 99.9% SLO for the routing lane for the commitment term.

Key items I need signoff on from ops/finance/legal:
- Approve 25% concession (one-time executive approval)
- Limit term to 12 months; price auto-reverts to list after term
- SOW to include usage measurement and auto-rebate clause tied to MTU
- Legal to confirm data handling/residency language for the dedicated lane

Ive attached our pricing model and a draft SOW for the CardinalIQ PS lead to review. If we can get internal clearance today Ill loop in procurement and push for an invoice/SOW signature early next week.

Thanks —
Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments: CardinalIQ_pricing_model_v3.xlsx, CardinalIQ_SOW_draft.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: approval for non-standard Hosted API pricing for CardinalIQ

Team —

Forwarding CardinalIQ's request and Ben's recommended go/no-go. Executive approval needed because this is a >20% deviation from list Price. My recommendation: approve 25% concession conditioned on the following guardrails:

- Term: 12 months firm commit with monthly minimum of $250k ARR
- Scorecard: SLAs and routing lane availability measured monthly; failure triggers proportional rebates and potential early termination of concession
- Legal: require standard indemnity and no expanded data access; include audit right limited to the routing lane metrics
- Auto-revert: prices return to list at renewal; any extension requires re-approval

Rationale: CardinalIQ is strategic — they bring multi-region pilot and likely add Dedicated next year. We preserve margin by limiting term and tying to firm spend.

Please reply with explicit OK/NOK and any redlines by EOD so Ben can respond to their procurement deadline Tues.

-Marissa
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: approval for non-standard Hosted API pricing for CardinalIQ

Marissa / Ben —

After reviewing the attached pricing model and expected consumption profile, finance can approve a 25% one-year concession under the guardrails you proposed. Conditions from finance:

- Concession is a one-time executive-approved price override limited to 12 months; no automatic renewal of the concession.
- CardinalIQ must accept the attached SOW and the usage measurement appendix (attached) before invoice issuance.
- Include a monthly reconciliation clause and a spend true-up at quarter end; if consumption is <85% of committed monthly tokens for two consecutive months we reserve the right to step down the concession.
- Legal signoff required on residency and routing lane language prior to binding signature (Neha, please advise if the clause below is acceptable).

If legal greenlights the routing/residency language, Ill route a formal exec memo and sign-off log to the CEO. Im okay signing the concession at 25% provided Legal and Sales accept the conditions above.

-Mina
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: CardinalIQ_pricing_model_v3.xlsx
